title: CNTK Public GitHub Release
summary: Microsoft announced on January 25, 2016 that it was releasing its Computational Network Toolkit (CNTK), an open-source deep-learning toolkit used by Microsoft researchers, on GitHub.
significance: A dated public-availability milestone for CNTK, preserved separately from the toolkit's earlier internal development and research-publication history.

verification.note: Microsoft's dated January 25, 2016 announcement explicitly states that the company was releasing CNTK on GitHub. A June 10, 2016 Microsoft Research post independently states that earlier that year Microsoft made the open-source CNTK available on GitHub. This candidate records the public GitHub-release milestone only; it does not infer CNTK's invention date, development-start date, development geography, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edges.
